people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoahaz
people.line: King of Israel, son of Jehu

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Jehoahaz begged Yahweh, and Yahweh listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.
translations.bsb: Then Jehoahaz sought the favor of the LORD, and the LORD listened to him because He saw the oppression that the king of Aram had inflicted on Israel.
translations.kjv: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
translations.asv: And Jehoahaz besought Jehovah, and Jehovah hearkened unto him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how that the king of Syria oppressed them.
